issues.description: The return type of getStockIngredients in Stock differs between the template and the solution. In the template Stock.getStockIngredients() returns a List<StockIngredient> (template: src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java lines 17-19), while in the solution it returns a StockIngredient[] (solution: src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java lines 14-16). This inconsistency can confuse students when comparing the template API with the provided solution and may lead to compilation issues if they attempt to follow the solution implementation against the template method signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getStockIngredients() method consistent across template and solution. Preferably update the template to match the solution by changing the template method signature to return StockIngredient[] (and adjust imports/usages accordingly), or update the solution to return List<StockIngredient>. Ensure both repositories use the same return type so students are not confused by differing APIs.
